changelog: New red equalizer app icon, animated splash screen, and notification icon.
Login and welcome screens now use the new logo.
Meoify Wrapped moved to Settings; removed from the library screen and create menu.
Wrapped stats now only count a track when it plays to completion (skips and fast-forwards no longer count).
Removed the "Folder" option from the create menu.
Settings tagline updated to "Purr-fectly tuned: Spotify's flow, YouTube's catalog, and Material 3 design."
Default theme is now Light; dynamic color is off by default.
Removed the YouTube Music sync status line from the account section.
"Remove from playlist" now updates the list immediately.
Update checker now falls back to the GitHub releases feed and re-checks on app resume.
Notification icon enlarged for better visibility.
